profile.name: Rohan Sharma
profile.occupationOrSchedule: B.Tech CS Undergrad (Final Exams in 4 Days)

medical.physicalLimitations: Severe desk neck strain from coding sprints
medicalPrecautions: Postural Decompression: Focused thoracic extensions & scapular retractions added.
Plant-Based Optimization: High-bioavailability legumes, oats, and nut proteins prioritized.

baselineRoutine.title: Standard Gym Hypertrophy & Strength Split
baselineRoutine.examFriendlyNotes: Commercial standard gym equipment split. Features Olympic barbells, cable stations, dumbbell racks, and machine presses.
baselineRoutine.medicalClearanceNotes: Full orthopedic posture checklist, acromion spacing clearance, and spinal decompression cues.

exercises.name: Flat Olympic Barbell Bench Press
exercises.dormEquipmentNeeded: Olympic Bench, 20kg Olympic Barbell & Weight Plates
exercises.targetBenefit: Pectoralis Major (Sternal & Clavicular), Triceps Brachii, Anterior Deltoids
exercises.postureFocus: 5-point contact, retract scapulae firmly into bench pad, maintain natural lumbar arch, elbows 45-70°
exercises.medicalSafetyNote: Subacromial Impingement Prevention: Never flare elbows at 90° or use suicide/thumbless grip.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown Machine
exercises.dormEquipmentNeeded: Cable Lat Pulldown Station & Wide Bar
exercises.targetBenefit: Latissimus Dorsi, Teres Major, Rhomboids, Biceps Brachii
exercises.postureFocus: Thighs locked under pad, pull smoothly to clavicle, slight 15° torso lean
exercises.medicalSafetyNote: Cervical Spine Protection: Never pull behind neck; pull to front of chest only.

exercises.name: Standing Olympic / EZ-Bar Bicep Curls
exercises.targetBenefit: Biceps Brachii (Short & Long heads), Brachialis, Forearm Flexors
exercises.postureFocus: Elbows pinned to flanks, neutral straight wrists, zero lumbar backward swing
exercises.medicalSafetyNote: Carpal Tunnel Safety: EZ-bar angle reduces wrist supination torque and joint stress.

exercises.name: Triceps Cable Rope Pushdowns
exercises.targetBenefit: Triceps Brachii (Lateral, Medial, and Long Heads)
exercises.postureFocus: Elbows glued to ribcage, 10° hip hinge, flare rope outward at bottom lockout
exercises.medicalSafetyNote: Olecranon Bursa Protection: Avoid snapping joints into hyperextended lockout.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Incline Leg Press Machine
exercises.postureFocus: Back and hips flat on backrest pad, feet shoulder-width, soft micro-bend at top
exercises.medicalSafetyNote: Spinal Disc & Patellar Safety: Never lock knees out or allow glutes to lift off seat.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Overhead Press
exercises.targetBenefit: Anterior & Medial Deltoids, Trapezius, Core Stabilizers
exercises.postureFocus: Vertical backrest support, press in scapular plane 30° forward of coronal plane
exercises.medicalSafetyNote: Rotator Cuff Clearance: Avoid pressing behind neck; keep elbows slightly forward.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee / Leg Raises on Captain's Chair
exercises.dormEquipmentNeeded: Captain's Chair / Roman Chair or Pull-up Rig
exercises.postureFocus: Forearms anchored firmly on arm rests, tuck knees to chest without swinging
exercises.medicalSafetyNote: Lumbar Decompression: Excellent for decompressing spine after heavy squats or desk work.

scaledRoutine.title: Restorative Gym Mobility & Cable Deload
scaledRoutine.examFriendlyNotes: Shortened 20m routine using cable stations and light machines to decompress spine and relieve CNS stress.
scaledRoutine.medicalClearanceNotes: Focuses on mobility, stress relief, and gentle joint recovery without axial load.

meals.name: Oatmeal Peanut Butter Power Bowl
meals.studentHack: Use the kettle to boil water, pour over oats in a bowl, cover for 3 mins.
meals.medicalDietNote: Vegetarian, easy to digest for workout fuel and study focus

meals.name: Microwave Lentil & Rice High-Protein Bowl
meals.studentHack: Buy canned lentils; rinse and microwave with rice for a complete muscle-recovery meal.
meals.medicalDietNote: Vegetarian, high fiber and complex carbohydrates for sustained energy
